# Vendored browser library

`qrcode.min.js` is generated from the pinned `qrcode` npm package (`1.5.4`) with the `build:qr` script. The package is maintained at [soldair/node-qrcode](https://github.com/soldair/node-qrcode) and distributed under the MIT license. Its license text is included in `node_modules/qrcode/license` when dependencies are installed.

Regenerate after `npm ci` with `npm run build:qr`.
